text: The Chief of Protocol, Strategic Protocol and External Relations, City Clerk's Office, will give an overview presentation on Strategic Protocol and External Relations and consult on the 2022 Work Plan for the City of Toronto's recognition approach for Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer recognition initiatives.

The Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee: 1. Requested the Chief of Protocol to incorporate the Committee's feedback into the 2022 Work Plan for the City's recognition approach for Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer recognition initiatives.
